At the Annual Meeting of Shareholders of The Campbell's Company (the "Company"), which was held on November 17, 2026 (the “2026 Annual Meeting”), the Company's shareholders approved the Amended and Restated 2022 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the “Amended and Restated Plan”). The Amended and Restated Plan was previously approved, subject to shareholder approval, by the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of the Company. The Amended and Restated Plan amends and restates in its entirety the Company's 2022 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the "2022 Plan") by (i) increasing the number of shares available for issuance by 9,000,000 shares, which increases the total number of shares authorized for issuance from 12,000,000 shares to 21,000,000 shares; (ii) adding a minimum one-year vesting period term for awards, subject to customary exceptions; and (iii) making various administrative amendments approved by the Board that do not require shareholder approval according to the 2022 Plan and the rules of The Nasdaq Stock Market. A summary of the material terms and conditions of the Amended and Restated Plan and awards thereunder is included in the Company's definitive proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 7, 2026 (the “Proxy Statement”) under “Item 4: Amendment and Restatement of the Company's 2022 Long-Term Incentive Plan,” which section is incorporated herein by reference. The foregoing descriptions are qualified in their entirety by reference to the Amended and Restated Plan, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 hereto and incorporated herein by reference.
